tests.title: verify-signals workflow simulation remains deterministic across two consecutive runs with the same payload.
tests.description: This deep workflow test checks reproducibility by running the same simulation twice back-to-back. It catches hidden nondeterminism and state leakage between runs.
steps: Run cre workflow simulate verify-signals with deterministic fixture
Run the same simulation again with identical fixture
Compare key output markers and confirm deterministic behavior
tests.successCriteria: Both runs succeed and output shape remains deterministic for key fields.
